title: Desarguesianity of Maiorana-McFarland derivative spreads
summary: Decide whether every derivative-kernel spread arising from the source Maiorana-McFarland family is Desarguesian.

formal_statement.body: For every admissible member of the source family $$F_{r,\Lambda,\gamma}(x)=\operatorname{Tr}_m^{2m}\!\left(\gamma x^{2^r}\operatorname{Tr}_m^{2m}(\Lambda(x))\right),$$ is the spread formed by the kernels of $D_aF_{r,\Lambda,\gamma}$ for nonzero $a$ Desarguesian? Prove this for the full family, or construct and verify one non-Desarguesian member.

scope.domain: Derivative-kernel spreads of the source Maiorana-McFarland vectorial bent family
assumptions: $\Lambda$ is an admissible source-defined linearized permutation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove that every admissible source-family spread is Desarguesian, or give one rigorously verified non-Desarguesian counterexample.

progress.summary: The source asks whether all derivative-kernel spreads produced by its exact Maiorana-McFarland family are Desarguesian.
